text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the approval of parking for a maximum period of one-hour, in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., daily on the east side of Lesmount Avenue, between Cosburn Avenue and Memorial Park Avenue. The proposed amendment will discourage long-term daytime parking, and increase parking turnover on this section of Lesmount Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item indefinitely.
